// rules=9 default-mode=log explicit-modes block=0/log=0/off=0

// sqli-union-select (priority 100, block): union select 注入探测
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "(?i)union(?:[+%20]|\\s)+(?:all\\s+)?select"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "sqli-union-select");
}

// sqli-time-function (priority 110, block): SQL 延时函数探测
if ((strings.match($req.query, "(?i)(?:sleep|benchmark|waitfor|pg_sleep)\\s*\\("))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "sqli-time-function");
}

// rce-jndi-probe (priority 120, block): JNDI 注入探测（log4shell 形态）
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "(?i)[$][{]jndi:") || strings.match($header.user_agent, "(?i)[$][{]jndi:") || strings.match($header.referer, "(?i)[$][{]jndi:"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "rce-jndi-probe");
}

// xss-script-marker (priority 200, block): XSS 脚本标记探测
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "(?i)(?:<\\s*script|<\\s*iframe|javascript:|on(?:error|load|click)\\s*=)"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "xss-script-marker");
}

// traversal-encoded-dotdot (priority 300, block): 路径穿越探测（含编码变体）
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "(?i)(?:[.][.]|%2e%2e|%252e%252e)(?:/|%2f|%5c|%255c)"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "traversal-encoded-dotdot");
}

// scanner-user-agent (priority 400, log): 扫描器 User-Agent
if ((strings.match($header.user_agent, "(?i)(?:sqlmap|nikto|nmap|masscan|zgrab|acunetix|nessus|dirbuster|gobuster|wpscan)"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "scanner-user-agent");
}

// probe-sensitive-file (priority 410, log): 敏感文件与管理端探测
if ((strings.match($req.path, "(?i)^/[.](?:env|git|htaccess|htpasswd|ssh|aws)|/(?:phpmyadmin|wp-admin|wp-login[.]php|actuator)(?:/|$)"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "probe-sensitive-file");
}

// malformed-control-chars (priority 500, block): URI 控制字符
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "malformed-control-chars");
}

// malformed-triple-encoding (priority 510, log): 三重百分号编码探测
if ((strings.match($req.uri, "%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}%[0-9a-f]{2}"))) {
    ctx.report("waf.log", "malformed-triple-encoding");
}

return true;
